title: News Related Reflections on the Synod 2024
html:
African Bishops Pleased With Outcome of Synod, Leading Prelate Says

October 29, 2024 | Edward Pentin | National Catholic Register

Article discusses how African bishops played a key role in fending off efforts to give episcopal conferences greater doctrinal autonomy at the Synod on Synodality.

View article

Synod’s end opens door to New Synodal Order for a new Church

October 28, 2024 | Stefano Fontana | Daily Compass

“An interlocutory document, adopted by the Pope, concludes the work of the Synod. But what is considered by some to be a step backwards compared to the expected progressive openings, is actually a sign that what is wanted is the synodal process that, without haste, will create a new Church.”

View article

‘An endless party,’ not an ‘aged marriage’: Pope approves synod’s final document, will not issue apostolic exhortation

October 28, 2024 | Catholic Culture

Article discusses Pope Francis’ approval of the synod’s 53-page final document and decision no to issue an apostolic exhortation.

View article

One, Many Cardinal Fernández Fiascos

October 26, 2024 | Fr. Raymond J. de Souza | The Catholic Thing

Article discusses how Cardinal Fernández has undermined synodality and how synodality is a window dressing for the real maneuvers that take place behind closed doors: On issues of significant importance, secret processes without consultation are the preferred method of proceeding.

View article

The First Object of the Church: Holiness

October 24, 2024 | Michael Pakaluk | The Catholic Thing

Article discusses how the Synod on Synodality seems to give no attention to holiness and how its members views synodal as if it were itself the essence of holiness, true belief and following the moral law as dispensable, and Christian charity as procedural.

View article

As Synod’s End Nears, Progressives Brace for Disappointment — And Blame Organizers

October 23, 2024 | Jonathan Liedl | National Catholic Register

Article discusses how progressive Catholics feel led astray by synod organizers’ grand promises, where major issues were sidelined and major changes were seemingly off the table.

View article

Cardinal Brandmüller warns against Synod proposal to give local bishops undue ‘doctrinal authority’

October 21, 2024 | Michael Haynes | LifeSite News

Article discusses Cardinal Walter Brandmüller’s criticism of a Synod on Synodality proposal for bishops’ conferences to hold more authority and autonomy, saying that their further empowerment is “an expression and a cause of a creeping process of secularization of the Church in our day.”

View article

What Are Synods Good For?

October 21, 2024 | Msgr. Hans Feichtinger | The Catholic Thing

Article discusses how synods are good for keeping the Church unified in the one faith in the one Saviour and defining and clarifying this faith.

View article

Cardinal Zen calls out ‘incredible arrogance’ and inconsistency of Vatican’s approval of same-sex blessings without consulting synod

October 19, 2024 | Charles Collins | Catholic Herald

Article discusses Cardinal Zen’s view that the Synod is suffering from same-sex marriage advocacy.

View article

A Brief History of Our Troubles – and Some Hope

October 19, 2024 | Rev. Jerry J. Pokorsky | The Catholic Thing

Article discusses the history of the Church’s views on contraception and homosexuality

Synod, Zen, and sinicization: Vatican’s China deal sparks tensions

October 19, 2024 | AC Wimmer | Catholic News Agency

Article discusses the criticisms leveraged against the Synod by Cardinal Joseph Zen and American author George Weigel. In particular, the Synod’s approach to China.

Analysis: Is the Synod on Synodality’s focus on the local Churches a Trojan horse?

October 18, 2024 | Andrea Gagliarducci | Catholic News Agency

Article discusses how the issues, such as ecclesiastical governance and the relationship between the local Churches and the universal Church, may be used as a Trojan Horse to sneak sidelined issues such as married priests and female ordination into the Synod.

Cardinal Zen warns Synod aims ‘to overthrow’ Church’s hierarchy for ‘a democratic system’

October 17, 2024 | Michael Haynes | LifeSite News

Article discusses Cardinal Zen’s viewpoints on the Synod and his warning not to replace the Church’s hierarchy with a more democratic system.

Australian archbishop: Synod on Synodality cannot ‘reinvent the Catholic faith’

October 16, 2024 | Hannah Brockhaus | Catholic News Agency

Article discusses whether the bishops have the authority to teach different Catholicism in different countries. For example: They discuss whether local culture should influence a local interpretation of morals.

Article discusses issues of transgenderism and what it means to be “welcome” in the Catholic Church.

Article discusses how special interest groups may attempt to influence outcomes of the Synod.

October 14, 2024, 2024 | Phil Lawler | Catholic Culture

Article discusses Pope Francis’ meeting with transgender advocates.

Personal Experience, Not Moral Absolutes, to Steer Synod Study Group’s Discernment on Sexuality Questions

October 3, 2024 | Jonathan Liedl | National Catholic Register

A study group established by Pope Francis to develop a synodal way of discerning Catholic Church teaching on so-called controversial issues, including sexual morality and life issues, has proposed what it calls a “new paradigm” that is heavy on situational ethics but minimizes moral absolutes and established Church teaching.

Never-before-seen writing of Pope Benedict XVI discovered, published by Vatican analyst

October 1, 2024 | Louis Knuffke | CatholicVote

The Veritas Amoris Project has just published a never-before-seen text of Pope Benedict XVI addressing some of the fundamental crises of our day.
